releases.name: v2.0.4
releases.body:
## What's Changed
* Keep snap previews translucent with Reduce Transparency by @kiteretsu903 in https://github.com/rxhanson/Rectangle/pull/1898
* Isolate and improve optional window animations by @kiteretsu903 in https://github.com/rxhanson/Rectangle/pull/1886
* Avoid redundant Accessibility writes during ordinary window placement by @kiteretsu903 in https://github.com/rxhanson/Rectangle/pull/1899
* Add mouse button shortcuts for window actions by @harshpatel333 in https://github.com/rxhanson/Rectangle/pull/1895
* Add Persian (fa) localization by @aliafshany in https://github.com/rxhanson/Rectangle/pull/1910
* Keep snap-preview material and geometry in sync by @kiteretsu903 in https://github.com/rxhanson/Rectangle/pull/1900
* Add an option to snap before reaching outer screen edges by @kiteretsu903 in https://github.com/rxhanson/Rectangle/pull/1901
* Sort the stacked-window list alphabetically by @MyronKoch in https://github.com/rxhanson/Rectangle/pull/1909
* Persian: fix right-to-left layout of the accessibility prompt by @aliafshany in https://github.com/rxhanson/Rectangle/pull/1914
* Honor screenEdgeGapTopNotch when it is set to 0 by @efim0v in https://github.com/rxhanson/Rectangle/pull/1911
* Complete the Simplified Chinese (zh-Hans) localization by @AkiyamaKunka in https://github.com/rxhanson/Rectangle/pull/1916
* Add regression coverage for Todo placement on offset displays by @culpen90 in https://github.com/rxhanson/Rectangle/pull/1919
* Add full-height vertical sixth window actions by @ehippy in https://github.com/rxhanson/Rectangle/pull/1917
* Complete the Brazilian Portuguese (pt-BR) localization by @OCampezzi in https://github.com/rxhanson/Rectangle/pull/1918
* Ukrainian localization by @lsl87Serhii in https://github.com/rxhanson/Rectangle/pull/1923
* Add a Simplified Chinese README by @AkiyamaKunka in https://github.com/rxhanson/Rectangle/pull/1928
* Add a repeated-commands option that switches to the opposite side by @AkiyamaKunka in https://github.com/rxhanson/Rectangle/pull/1925
* Fix drag-snap window detection for Emacs 28 by @culpen90 in https://github.com/rxhanson/Rectangle/pull/1926
* Give Debug builds their own bundle identifier by @AkiyamaKunka in https://github.com/rxhanson/Rectangle/pull/1927
* Point README to the 2.0 Settings tabs by @AkiyamaKunka in https://github.com/rxhanson/Rectangle/pull/1931
* Use a Chinese screenshot in README.zh-Hans.md by @AkiyamaKunka in https://github.com/rxhanson/Rectangle/pull/1936
* Document the alwaysAccountForStage hidden preference by @AkiyamaKunka in https://github.com/rxhanson/Rectangle/pull/1932
* Minor bug fixes by @rxhanson 

## New Contributors
* @aliafshany made their first contribution in https://github.com/rxhanson/Rectangle/pull/1910
* @efim0v made their first contribution in https://github.com/rxhanson/Rectangle/pull/1911
* @AkiyamaKunka made their first contribution in https://github.com/rxhanson/Rectangle/pull/1916
* @ehippy made their first contribution in https://github.com/rxhanson/Rectangle/pull/1917
* @OCampezzi made their first contribution in https://github.com/rxhanson/Rectangle/pull/1918
* @lsl87Serhii made their first contribution in https://github.com/rxhanson/Rectangle/pull/1923

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/rxhanson/Rectangle/compare/v2.0.3...v2.0.4
